program.merge_policy: accumulate twenty 25-finding passes; consolidate, admit, validate, and merge once after Wave 1000

source_provenance: PubMed cardiometabolic, prebiotic, algae, carotenoid and polyphenol systematic-review/meta-analysis literature

policy.validation_strategy: cheap PMID/entity screening during authoring; full repository validation only after Wave 1000

waves.focus: Ten-RCT/539-participant lipid meta-analysis; total and LDL cholesterol decreased while triglycerides and HDL were null, with weak supplement-characterization reporting across most trials.
2025 29-RCT/1,583-participant blood-pressure meta-analysis across edible algae; small pooled BP reductions with high heterogeneity and species-specific differences.
2026 updated RCT meta-analysis of cocoa flavanols for blood pressure and vascular function; BP and vascular indices remain surrogate endpoints with intervention heterogeneity.
2026 24-study GRADE dose-response meta-analysis; multiple metabolic/anthropometric biomarker signals but most outcome certainty was very low.
Eleven-study/546-participant prediabetes meta-analysis; body-fat percentage decreased while fasting glucose, insulin, HbA1c, HOMA-IR and lipid outcomes were null.
2025 cardiometabolic synthesis; BMI/waist, BP, selected lipids and insulin/HOMA-IR improved while weight, hip circumference, HDL, fasting glucose and HbA1c were null.
2025 23-study/1,035-participant review in overweight/obesity; weight/lipid/DBP signals with exercise-combination effects and substantial endpoint heterogeneity.
Five-RCT/230-participant historical BP meta-analysis; SBP/DBP reductions with small samples and subgroup dependence, useful against newer broader evidence.
2025 human systematic review of oxidative, inflammatory and metabolic outcomes; broad positive narrative signals require trial-level separation rather than a universal efficacy claim.
GRADE-assessed RCT meta-analysis of lycopene/tomato and cardiovascular risk factors; lipid, glycemic, BP, inflammatory and anthropometric outcomes remain endpoint-specific.
Twelve-RCT/380-participant meta-analysis; oxidative/inflammatory biomarker effects were modest and condition-dependent, without direct clinical-outcome evidence.

2026 11-RCT meta-analysis found no clinically meaningful continuous-intake glycemic or lipid benefit and sparse low-certainty inflammatory evidence—a strong counterweight to earlier positive OLE syntheses.
2026 COSMOS cardiovascular-outcome reanalysis using win-ratio methods; outcome-level evidence remains separate from short-term biomarker meta-analyses.
33-RCT meta-analysis; glucose, total cholesterol and triglyceride benefits appeared mainly in diabetes, with weight and insulin null overall and high unexplained heterogeneity.
2026 umbrella review of tomato-derived lycopene intervention reviews; cardiovascular-risk signals inherit underlying review quality, formulation and outcome heterogeneity.
2026 nine-RCT/403-participant prediabetes/T2D meta-analysis; glycemic/lipid signals with HOMA-IR, weight and BMI nulls.
Seven-study/321-participant metabolic-syndrome-risk review; marginal/selected lipid and BP signals with need for more robust evidence.
55-RCT/2,518-participant cardiovascular-risk meta-analysis; small LDL, triglyceride and weight reductions with little/no effect on most other outcomes and low/very-low certainty.
2025 PCOS systematic review/single-arm meta-analysis; oxidative and reproductive outcomes remain female-PCOS specific and limited by small trial evidence.
2024 RCT meta-analysis of fatigue, motor function and cognition; domain-specific findings remain distinct rather than generalized to global energy/cognitive enhancement.
2024 31-RCT/1,986-participant cardiometabolic meta-analysis; TC/LDL/glucose/BP signals with weight, BMI, waist, triglyceride, HDL and HbA1c nulls.
2026 metabolic-syndrome/related-disease meta-analysis; limited triglyceride-focused benefit with duration/disease modifiers and low certainty for broader metabolic claims.

2025 23-RCT systematic review of adults with metabolic-syndrome-related risks; anthropometric, glycemic, lipid, inflammatory and oxidative outcomes are resistant-starch-type and delivery-context dependent.
2025 11-RCT/506-participant T2D lipid meta-analysis; triglycerides decreased but other lipids did not, with severe heterogeneity and low-certainty/clinically small effects.
13-RCT/927-participant hypercholesterolemia meta-analysis; total/LDL cholesterol reductions with triglyceride/HDL nulls and source/dose/duration modifiers.
